classification.difficultyReason: One translated V graph. Locate the vertex (2,-4), then find both intercepts using |x-2|=4. Taught method with a single extra shift.

answer.worked:
1. $y$-intercept

$$\begin{align*}y&=|0-2|-4\\&=-2\end{align*}$$

2. $x$-intercepts

$$\begin{align*}0&=|x-2|-4\\4&=|x-2|\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}x-2&=4\\x&=6\end{align*}$$
or
$$\begin{align*}-(x-2)&=4\\x-2&=-4\\x&=-2\end{align*}$$

3. Turning point

$(2,-4)$

Notice that the left branch is $y=-x-2$ and the right branch is $y=x-6$.
